data.fund_name: HSBC Medium to Long Duration Fund
data.fund_type: An open-ended medium to long term debt scheme investing in instruments such that the Macaulay duration of the portfolio is between 4 years to 7 years. A relatively high interest rate risk and moderate credit risk.
data.investment_objective: To provide a reasonable income through a diversiﬁed portfolio of ﬁxed income securities such that the Macaulay duration of the portfolio is between 4 years to 7 years.
data.asset_allocation: Under normal circumstances, it is anticipated that the asset allocation of the Scheme will be as follows: - Debt & Money market instruments such that Macaulay duration* of the portfolio is between 4 years# to 7 years- 0%- 100% (Risk Proﬁle-Low to Medium) Asset allocation under anticipated adverse situation - Debt & Money market instruments such that Macaulay duration* of the portfolio is between 1 year# to 7 years :0%- 100% (Risk Proﬁle-Low to Medium)
data.benchmark: NIFTY Medium to Long Duration Debt Index A-III
data.fund_managers: FM 1 - Mohd. Asif Rizwi, FM 2 - Shriram Ramanathan
